verification: Every listed plain and annotated PDF has section 1384A in its contents but no legislative body for that section.
The January plain body was visually inspected at PDF page 932: section 1384(2) is followed directly by Part 24 and section 1385.
Before the hash-specific exception, direct parsing of the complete January plain source rejected only section 1384A.
Section 1384A was inserted by Act 9/2017 s.83 and commenced on 9 June 2017 under SIs 246/2017 and 250/2017.
source_manifestations: The official historical catalogue lists plain and annotated PDFs for these rows. Both variants have the same omission; no complete same-cutoff manifestation was found.
representation: Retain only the exact verified complete PDF files with an explicit per-version source warning; do not reconstruct the missing text. The parser exception permits only the exact missing section set {1384A} for each recorded plain SHA-256. All other missing sections and all other bytes remain errors.

presentation_equivalence.full_source_text_equal_after: Removing exact repeated running headers, the final numeric page footer and whitespace differences only; no punctuation or legislative text discarded.
